latest_release.name: v21.0.1
latest_release.body:
Version 21.0.0 had an issue where it failed to include our new TypeScript types in the published NPM bundle. Thanks to @PHILLIPS71 for the [pull request](https://github.com/facebook/relay/pull/5287) identifying and resolving the issue. This point release resolves that issue and includes a number of other minor improvements which have landed since to v21.0.0 release.
## Bug fixes
- Fix(build): ship TypeScript definition files in gulp dist build (#5287) by Jordan Phillips ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/2b59edeb4b39))
## Added
- Feat(compiler): add --noWatchman CLI flag (#5292) by Jordan Eldredge ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/ad24a51aa2ee))
## Improvements
- Feat: Warn on deprecated enum values used as arguments (#5277) by jungwoo3490 ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/fb7ffff7e84a))
- Add `shard_extra_artifacts` feature flag to shard PHP text artifacts by Tianyu Yao ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/54b8dcaaf7ea))
- Allow updatable fragments to be spread at the top level of another fragment by Rajiv Anisetti ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/dc0b087a9f08))
## Documentation Improvements
- Update v21 release notes, compiler CLI docs, and codemods guide by Jordan Eldredge ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/a0c0ca425448))
- Document fetchPolicy option for fetchQuery (#5244) by BatriÄ‡ PeroviÄ‡ ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/71b4e33c7332))
- Update Film import path to include file extension (#5243) by Meshack Ogeto ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/1eb75a72fb38))
- Fix the quickstart docs by Evan Yeung ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/769fe65724db))
- Relay 21 release notes blog post by Jordan Eldredge ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/ff9b2fed54f1))
## Miscellaneous
- Implement feature flag to gate rollout of flow modern syntax by Sam Zhou ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/045f22855450))
- Use simpler intersect algorithm by Matt Mahoney ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/4dcb3ffa8777))
- Update compiler clock to query result on subscribe by Shashank Kambhampati ([commit](https://github.com/facebook/relay/commit/e0bddc6acde0))
